{Sound:01:FD}What? You don't know what a {Color:Red}Kinstone
piece{Color:White} is? Well, tell you what...
Why don't you come back and see me
when you get one, OK?
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Co? Nevis, co je {Color:Red}kousek Kamene
osudu{Color:White}? No, vis co...
Proc se nevratis a nepodivas se
za mnou, az nejaky budes mit, OK?

en:
{Sound:01:FA}A visitor! How rare... I don't have much
to offer, but you're welcome to stay.
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Navsteva! To je vzacne... Moc toho
nenabidnu, ale klidne tu zustan.

en:
{Sound:02:00}What's that? You want to fuse
{Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}with me? Sure.
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Co je? Chces se mnou spojit
{Color:Red}kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}? Jasne.

en: {Sound:02:01}You're quitting?
cz: {Sound:02:01}Koncis?

en:
{Sound:02:02}We did it! They fit perfectly!
Maybe I'll get some luck finally!
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Dokazali jsme to! Sedi perfektne!
Mozna konecne budu mit stesti!

en:
{Sound:02:05}You moved the rock for me? Great!
I thought I'd never get outside!
cz:
{Sound:02:05}Posunul jsi pro me ten kamen? Skvele!
Myslel jsem, ze se nikdy nedostanu ven!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}Oh, you want to fuse with me?
Now let's see here...
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Och, chces se mnou spojit?
Tak se podivame...

en:
{Sound:01:FB}I guess it'll be a while before I find
a piece that fits this one...
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Asi to chvili potrva, nez najdu
kousek, ktery se hodi k tomuto...

en:
{Sound:01:FC}Look! They fit!
How lucky! Amazing, even!
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Podivej! Sedi!
To je stesti! Az uzasne!

en:
{Sound:01:F9}What's your problem?

Mmmm! You're staring at my amazingly
rare {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}, aren't you?!
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Co mas za problem?

Mmmm! Civis na muj uzasne vzacny
{Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}, ze?!

en:
{Sound:01:FA}How dare you! You want to fuse
my precious {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}?!
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Jak se opovazujes! Chces spojit
muj vzacny {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}?!

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Phew... Sweet little {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}.
It's OK. No one's gonna hurt you...{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Fuj... Sladky maly {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}.
To je dobry. Nikdo ti neublizi...{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:02:02}Ahh... They fit...
My poor little {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}...
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Ach... Sedi...
Muj chudak maly {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}...

en:
{Sound:02:03}Hey! Your clothes... You must be
human! Oh, I just LOVE human fashion!
I just can't help feeling that humans
are more sophisticated than {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
You know, I even think some other
{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}feel that way, too...
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Hej! Tve obleceni... Musis byt
clovek! Och, MILUJU lidskou modu!
Proste si nemuzu pomoct, ale clovek
je rafinovanejsi nez {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
Vis, myslim, ze i nekteri jini
{Color:Green}Minish {Color:White}to tak citi...

en:
{Sound:02:02}Water is life for {Color:Blue}Crenel Beans{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}

{Color:White}The blue beans grow when you pour
{Color:Red}water {Color:White}on them...
But the green beans like
{Color:Red}Mt. Crenel Mineral Water{Color:White}.{Color:Blue}
{Color:Red}Mt. Crenel Mineral Water {Color:White}can be found
only in a spring here on {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}.
Well, really, the spring is closer to
the base of {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Voda je zivot pro {Color:Blue}Crenelske faseole{Color:White}!{Color:Blue}

{Color:White}Modre faseole rostou, kdyz na ne
nalejes {Color:Red}vodu{Color:White}...
Ale zelene faseole maji rady
{Color:Red}mineralku z Mt. Crenel{Color:White}.{Color:Blue}
{Color:Red}Mineralku z Mt. Crenel {Color:White}najdes
jen v prameni zde na {Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}.
Vlastne, ten pramen je blize
k upati {Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:02:01}These {Color:Green}soldier statues{Color:Blue} {Color:White}here were built
by the Minish ages ago to help humans.
It's kind of a secret, but there's a
switch inside that {Color:Blue}turns them on or off{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Tyto {Color:Green}sochy vojaku{Color:Blue} {Color:White}zde postavili
Minish davno, aby pomahali lidem.
Je to tak trochu tajemstvi, ale uvnitr
je vypinac, ktery je {Color:Blue}zapina nebo vypina{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:02:01}Go get the {Color:Red}flippers {Color:White}from the {Color:Green}Minish
elder {Color:White}who lives in the library.
They'll make it so you can swim
through the water with ease.
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Bez si vyzvednout {Color:Red}plovaci blany {Color:White}od
{Color:Green}Minishskeho starsiho{Color:White}, ktery zije v knihovne.
Diky nim budes moct plavat
ve vode s lehkosti.

en:
{Sound:02:04}Can you solve my riddle?

{Color:Blue}Splish, splash, the sound of water.
He lives in the answer house.{Color:White}
I wonder if you'll meet my friend?
cz:
{Sound:02:04}Vyresis moji hadanku?

{Color:Blue}Slup, slap, zvuk vody.
Zije v dome odpovedi.{Color:White}
Zajimalo by me, jestli potkas meho kamarada?

en:
{Sound:02:04}{Color:Blue}A fearsome, unfriendly feline...
The answer lives here!{Color:White}
You did well to come this far.
Please take this.
cz:
{Sound:02:04}{Color:Blue}Hrozive, neprijemne kocicovite...
Odpoved zije zde!{Color:White}
Dobre jsi udelal, ze jsi dosel az sem.
Prosim, vezmi si toto.

en:
{Sound:01:FB}I gave you my last {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}
a while ago! But I'll go look for more.
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Pred chvili jsem ti dal posledni
{Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}! Ale pujdu hledat dalsi.

en:
{Sound:01:FC}Oh, ho! A visitor! How rare!

But you have found me, the
wisest of the wisest of the wise!
You what? You want to enter the
{Color:Blue}temple you can see in the lake{Color:White}?
They call that place the {Color:Green}Temple of
Droplets{Color:White}.
I have heard rumors that one Minish
actually did find a way in, long ago...
That Minish is {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}, and he is
in semi-retirement in the town library.
The library should be opening soon.
Perhaps you can go find him.
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Och, ho! Navsteva! To je vzacne!

Ale nasel jsi me, nejmoudrejsiho
z nejmoudrejsich z moudrych!
Ty co? Chces vstoupit do
{Color:Blue}chramu, co je videt v jezere{Color:White}?
Rikaji tomu mistu {Color:Green}Chram
Kapek{Color:White}.
Slysel jsem famy, ze jeden Minish
davno vskutku nasel cestu dovnitr...
Ten Minish je {Color:Green}Starsi Librari{Color:White}, ktery je
v polo-duchodu v mestske knihovne.
Knihovna by se mela brzy otevirat.
Mozna ho tam najdes.

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Yes, the elder Librari once found an
entrance to the Temple of Droplets.
And now, he lives in the town library!

And this is all the wisdom of the wisest
of the wise I have to offer you!
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Ano, starsi Librari kdysi nasel
vchod do Chramu Kapek.
A ted zije v mestske knihovne!

A to je vsechna moudrost nejmoudrejsiho
z moudrych, kterou ti mohu nabidnout!

en:
{Sound:02:05}So you met with elder Librari?!

And he said that he really HAS been
inside of the Temple of Droplets?
I knew it! Once again, my wisdom has
surpassed the wisdom of the wisest!
cz:
{Sound:02:05}Tak jsi se setkal se starsim Librarim?!

A on rekl, ze opravdu BYL
uvnitr Chramu Kapek?
Vedel jsem to! Opet ma moudrost
prekonala moudrost nejmoudrejsiho!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}I have lots of wise and thought-
provoking information...
But nothing for you right now.
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Mam spoustu moudrych a podnetnych
informaci...
Ale nic pro tebe ted nemam.

en:
{Sound:02:03}Hello! How nice to have a visitor!{Symbol:0B}

But...I'm having some trouble!

They've changed the room around, and
now I can't get into the fireplace!
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Ahoj! Jak je prijemne mit navstevu!{Symbol:0B}

Ale...mam nejake problemy!

Prestavili mistnost a ted
se nedostanu do krbu!

en:
{Sound:02:02}They've changed the room around!
It's terrible now! So gauche!
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Prestavili mistnost!
Ted je to hrozne! Tak nevkusne!

en:
{Sound:02:03}Thank you! Now I can climb in through
the fireplace and get some sleep!
cz:
{Sound:02:03}Diky! Ted se mohu vyskrabat
krbem a trochu si pospat!

en:
Welcome to the library!

Say, aren't you Smith's grandson,
{Player}?
Hm? The books missing from the
bookshelf on the second floor?
Yes, they've been checked out for
quite a while. They're VERY overdue!
{07:49:02}
cz:
Vitej v knihovne!

Hele, nejsi ty Smithuv vnuk,
{Player}?
Hmm? Knihy chybejici z polic
v druhem patre?
Ano, jsou pujcene uz dost
dlouho. Jsou MOC po lhute!
{07:49:02}

en:
Take {Color:Red}A Hyrulean Bestiary{Color:White}, for
example. Been gone for ages.
Checked out by {Color:Blue}a girl with a cat{Color:White}. She
said she had a new cat at her house.
Wanted to learn more about it, she did.
cz:
Vezmi treba {Color:Red}Hyrulskou bestiar{Color:White}.
Uz je pryc vecnost.
Pujcila si ji {Color:Blue}divka s kockou{Color:White}. Rikala,
ze ma doma novou kocku.
Chtela se o ni dozvedet vic.

en:
The next overdue book is...
Let's see...
Ah, yes! Of course...{Color:Red}Legend of the
Picori{Color:White}! It's been out forever!
It was checked out by a somewhat
{Color:Blue}absentminded scholar{Color:White}, I believe...
cz:
Dalsi prosla kniha je...
Podivejme se...
Ach, ano! Samozrejme...{Color:Red}Legenda o
Picori{Color:White}! Je venku navzdy!
Pujcil si ji jakysi
{Color:Blue}roztrziteny ucenec{Color:White}, myslim...

en:
And the last book we still need
is {Color:Red}A History of Masks{Color:White}.
I think it was checked out by {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White},
the mayor.
How could he keep a library book
so long! He's a public official!
cz:
A posledni kniha, kterou stale
potrebujeme, je {Color:Red}Historie masek{Color:White}.
Myslim, ze si ji pujcil {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White},
starosta.
Jak si mohl drzet knihovni knihu
tak dlouho! Vzdyt je verejny cinitel!

en:
Hey! Look at that! Our long-lost copy
of {Color:Red}A Hyrulean Bestiary{Color:White}!
{Player}, are you returning
this book?! Thank you so much!
I can't begin to describe how much I'm
looking forward to putting this back!
cz:
Hej! Podivej! Nas davno ztraceny
exemplar {Color:Red}Hyrulske bestiare{Color:White}!
{Player}, ty tu knihu
vracis?! Mockrat dekuji!
Neumim popsat, jak moc se tesim,
ze ji budu moct vratit zpet!

en:
Oh my goodness, will you look at that!

It's our copy of {Color:Red}Legend of the Picori{Color:White}!
It's been checked out for so long!
{Player}, you deserve a medal
for all this!
I am moved... Deeply, deeply moved
by this thoughtful gesture!
cz:
Och, jeminkote, podivej se na to!

Je to nas exemplar {Color:Red}Legendy o Picori{Color:White}!
Byl pujceny tak dlouho!
{Player}, zaslouzis za vsechno
toto medaili!
Jsem dojaty... Hluboce, hluboce dojaty
timto laskavym gestem!

en:
Would you look at that! I can't believe
it! It's our copy of {Color:Red}A History of Masks{Color:White}!
That mayor of ours is a real piece of
work, isn't he?
It must have been quite a challenge
to get this back from him.
You are my new favorite person,
{Player}! Thank you so much!
cz:
Podivej se na to! Tomu nemuzu uverit!
Je to nas exemplar {Color:Red}Historie masek{Color:White}!
Ten nas starosta je opravdu
kousek, ze?
Muselo byt dost vyzvou
dostat to od nej zpet.
Jsi ma nova oblibena osoba,
{Player}! Mockrat dekuji!

en:
You know, {Player}, you've now
returned all of our overdue books!
Now I can finally get that bookshelf
on the second floor in order!
Hey, {Color:Green}Sturgeon{Color:White}! Books to shelve!!
cz:
Vis, {Player}, ted jsi vratil
vsechny nase prodlouzene knihy!
Konecne mohu dat tu polici
v druhem patre do poradku!
Hej, {Color:Green}Sturgeone{Color:White}! Knihy k zalozeni!!

en:
Yes, yes! Here I am! I'm here! I'll have
these books put away lickety-split!
cz:
Ano, ano! Tady jsem! Jsem tu! Tyto
knihy ulozim jedna dve!

en:
{Sound:00:DB}Sometimes, these books move on their
own! I've seen it with my own two eyes!
An' don't tell me I'm crazy!
I ain't crazy!
cz:
{Sound:00:DB}Nekdy se tyto knihy pohybuji samy
od sebe! Videl jsem to na vlastni oci!
A nerikej, ze jsem blazen!
Nejsem blazen!

en:
Say, {Color:Green}Sturgeon{Color:White}, on the second floor,
has been acting a little strange.
He keeps babbling about the books
moving around on their own!
Do you think maybe we have rats
or something up there?
cz:
Vis, {Color:Green}Sturgeon{Color:White}, v druhem patre,
se chova trochu divne.
Porad blabli o knihach, ktere
se pohybuji samy!
Myslis, ze mame mozna nahore
krysy nebo neco takoveho?

en:
I'm in charge of checking out books,
so it's not my problem.
Still, I feel really bad for the girl
over there in charge of returns...
cz:
Mam na starosti pujcovani knih,
takze to neni muj problem.
Presto je mi opravdu lito te divky,
co ma na starosti vraceni...

en:
Folks don't come up here so often.
I get a touch lonely on my own.
cz:
Lide sem nahoru nechodi casto.
Sam jsem trochu opusteny.

en:
Welcome to the library!

Hey! Aren't you Smith's grandson,
{Player}? Enjoy your browsing!
cz:
Vitej v knihovne!

Hej! Nejsi ty Smithuv vnuk,
{Player}? Uzij si prohlizeni!

en:
The bookshelves are back in order!
Ah, I feel so...so...renewed!
Enjoy your browsing!
cz:
Police jsou zpatky v poradku!
Ach, citim se tak...tak...obnoven!
Uzij si prohlizeni!

en: Wonder what I should check out today.
cz: Zajimalo by me, co bych si dnes mel pujcit.

en:
Oh ho ho! All the books are back
on the shelves! Isn't it grand!
cz:
Och ho ho! Vsechny knihy jsou zpet
na policich! Neni to bajecne!

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Hey, hey, hey! This is no good!
No good at all!
The humans have {Color:Blue}checked some books
out of the library{Color:White}!
Thanks to them, none of us can get
back to {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}...
How will he get by all alone?
I'm so worried...
I'm sure the {Color:Green}librarian{Color:White} knows something
about where those books went...
I wish I were big. Why, I'd walk right
up and ask her where those books went!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Hej, hej, hej! Tohle neni dobre!
Vubec ne dobre!
Lide {Color:Blue}pujcili nejake knihy
z knihovny{Color:White}!
Kvuli nim se zadny z nas nedostane
zpet ke {Color:Green}Starsimu Librarimu{Color:White}...
Jak to tam zvladne uplne sam?
Mam takovou starost...
Jsem si jisty, ze {Color:Green}knihovnice{Color:White} neco vi
o tom, kam ty knihy zmizely...
Kez bych byl velky. To bych si k ni
prisel a zeptal se ji, kde jsou!

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Hey, hey, hey! Listen up! Listen good!
The books are back now!
It's true! It's true! Haha!
Now we can get back to {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}!
So you brought the books back?
Good for you! Thank you!
{07:4A:04}
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Hej, hej, hej! Poslouchejte! Poslouchejte dobre!
Knihy jsou zpet!
Je to pravda! Je to pravda! Haha!
Ted se muzeme vratit ke {Color:Green}Starsimu Librarimu{Color:White}!
Takze tys ty knihy prinesl zpet?
Vyborne! Diky!
{07:4A:04}

en:
{Sound:01:FE}Please take this as a
sign of our thanks!
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Prosim, vezmi si toto jako
znameni nasi vdecnosti!

en:
{Sound:02:00}I'd better get back to {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}
now! He'll be wondering where I am.
Especially now that I can climb over the
books, right? I mean, it's so easy now!
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Radsi se vratim ke {Color:Green}Starsimu Librarimu{Color:White}
ted! Bude se divit, kde jsem.
Obzvlast ted, kdyz mohu prelezt
knihy, vid? Je to ted tak snadne!

en: {Sound:02:05}Thanks again for your help!
cz: {Sound:02:05}Jeste jednou diky za pomoc!

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}007
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}008

{Sound:01:F7}What a great combo!

You're going to meet
{Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White} and {Color:Green}Jotori{Color:White}?
Oh, and how about Librari's long,
boring adventure stories? Haha!
Talk about thrilling! Har har!

Well, if you're going over there,
just climb over the books!
cz:
{Sound:01:F7}To je skvela kombinace!

Jdes potkat
{Color:Green}Starsiho Librariho{Color:White} a {Color:Green}Jotoriho{Color:White}?
Och, a co Librariho dlouhe,
nudne dobrodruzne pribehy? Haha!
To je teprve napinave! Har har!

No, kdyz tam jdes,
proste prelez knihy!

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}010

{Sound:01:F8}We can't get up the shelf, because
some human checked that book out!
But at least we don't have to listen to
{Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}'s boring old stories!
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Nedostaneme se na polici, protoze
nejaky clovek pujcil tu knihu!
Ale aspon nemusime poslouchat
nudne stare pribehy {Color:Green}Starsiho Librariho{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:01:F9}Ahh, it's so nice to have all my little
books in a row!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Ach, je tak prijemne mit vsechny
me male knizky v rade!{Symbol:0B}

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}013
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}014
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}015
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}016

{Sound:02:05}I am {Color:Green}Jotori{Color:White}, one of {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}'s students!

And to be perfectly honest, I think
that {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}'s adventure stories are...
{Sound:01:FD}The best!!
No, really!
I may be a mental giant, but I have
the body of just a tiny Minish lad...
That's why I really admire strong folk!
cz:
{Sound:02:05}Ja jsem {Color:Green}Jotori{Color:White}, jeden z {Color:Green}Librariho{Color:White} zaku!

A upremne, myslim, ze
{Color:Green}Librariho{Color:White} dobrodruzne pribehy jsou...
{Sound:01:FD}Nejlepsi!!
Ne, opravdu!
Jsem mozna mentalni obr, ale mam
telo malickeho Minish chlapce...
Proto opravdu obdivuju silne lidi!

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}018

{Sound:01:FD}Oh! So you passed the trial and
returned with {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}'s flippers?
I'm so jealous!
I'm not much for exercise myself...
But if you're going on an adventure,
there's no one better to learn from!
Ah, that {Color:Green}Elder Librari{Color:White}! He's so manly!
So brave! And so full of FIRE!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Och! Tak jsi prosel zkouskou a
vratil se s {Color:Green}Starsiho Librariho{Color:White} plovacimi blanami?
Mam takovou zavist!
Na cviceni sam moc nejsem...
Ale kdyz jdes na dobrodruzstvi,
neni od koho se lepe ucit!
Ach, ten {Color:Green}Starsi Librari{Color:White}! Je tak muzny!
Tak statecny! A tak plny OHNE!

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}020
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}021
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}022
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}023
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}024

{Sound:02:0D}Wohohoho! What business have you
with old {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}?
But! Before you ask, please allow me
to introduce myself.
Wohohoho! Ahem, aheeeeem...

My name is {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}, and I have lived
many long years.
So many, in fact, that I've rather
forgotten how old I am!
But when I was young, oh,
I crossed mountain and sea!
I had many great adventures, but now
I stay here and teach students.
Yes, I enjoy my life of quiet study.
I have so many stories yet to tell...
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Wohohoho! Co mas za zajem
se starym {Color:Green}Librarim{Color:White}?
Ale! Nez se zeptas, dovol mi
se predstavit.
Wohohoho! Ehm, eheeeem...

Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White} a zil jsem
mnoho dlouhych let.
Tolik, ze jsem vlastne
zapomnel, kolik mi je!
Ale kdyz jsem byl mlady, och,
prekrocil jsem hory i more!
Mel jsem mnoho velkych dobrodruzstvi,
ale ted zustavam tu a ucim zaky.
Ano, uzivam si tichy zivot studia.
Mam jeste tolik pribehu k vypraveni...

en:
{Sound:02:0D}Yes, you are speaking to the world-
famous treasure-hunter {Color:Green}Librari{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Ano, mluvis se svetozname
lovcem pokladu {Color:Green}Librarim{Color:White}!

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}027
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}028
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}029
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}030
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}031
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}032
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HONDANA{Symbol:1F}033

{Sound:02:0D}Wohohoho! Oh?
A visitor after many long weeks!
Even {Color:Green}Jotari{Color:White} has been away so long,
I've grown almost...lonely.
...But what is it? What do you need?

Hm? You want to visit the {Color:Green}Temple of
Droplets{Color:White}?
Very well... You are the first such
brave person in a long while!
Stand on the clover in front of me!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Wohohoho! Och?
Navsteva po mnoha dlouhych tydnech!
Dokonce i {Color:Green}Jotari{Color:White} je pryc tak dlouho,
uz jsem skoro...osameli.
...Ale co je? Co potrebujes?

Hmm? Chces navstivit {Color:Green}Chram
Kapek{Color:White}?
Dobre... Jsi prvni takovy
statecny clovek po dlouhe dobe!
Postav se na trojlistek prede mnou!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}Hrmm?
What's this? What's this?
You want me to cut to the chase and
tell you about the {Color:Green}Temple of Droplets{Color:White}?
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Hmm?
Co to je? Co to je?
Chces, abych prestal a rekl
ti o {Color:Green}Chramu Kapek{Color:White}?

en:
{Sound:02:0D}All right, all right. You kids today...
No patience for an old man.
Well, just stand right there, like
I told you!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Dobre, dobre. Vy deti dnes...
Zadnou trpelivost pro stareho muze.
No, jen se postav tam,
kde jsem ti rekl!

en:
Wohoho!
Now...OPEN, secret mystery panel!!
cz:
Wohoho!
A ted...OTEVRI se, tajny mysticky panel!!

en:
Wohoho! Wasn't that fun?
Now then...
It's up to you to pass this {Color:Blue}trial {Color:White}safely
and recover the {Color:Red}item {Color:White}you require.
Oh, what fun! I do so love the real
nitty-gritty of adventuring!
cz:
Wohoho! Nebylo to zabavne?
A ted...
Je na tobe, abys bezpecne prosel touto
{Color:Blue}zkouskou{Color:White} a ziskal {Color:Red}predmet{Color:White}, ktery potrebujes.
Och, jak zabavne! Tak moc miluju
opravdovou podstatu dobrodruzstvi!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}Well done, indeed! Why, you're almost
as spry as I was at that age!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Vyborne, opravdu! Jsi skoro
tak svizny, jako jsem byl v tvem veku!

en: {Sound:01:F7}What a nice smell...
cz: {Sound:01:F7}Jak hezka vune...

en:
{Sound:01:FB}I like those red hats the Forest Minish
wear...
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Libi se mi ty cervene cepice, co nosi
Lesni Minish...

en:
{Sound:01:F8}I like these blue hats the Town
Minish wear...
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Libi se mi tyto modre cepice, co nosi
Mestsky Minish...

en:
{Sound:01:FD}The {Color:Green}Forest Minish{Color:White}
have come for a visit.
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}{Color:Green}Lesni Minish{Color:White}
prisli na navstevu.

en: {Sound:01:FF}I knew the city life would be exciting!
cz: {Sound:01:FF}Vedel jsem, ze zivot ve meste bude vzrusujici!

en: {Sound:02:01}Everyone here is so refined...
cz: {Sound:02:01}Vsichni tady jsou tak rafinovani...

en: {Sound:02:02}I get hungry just from that smell!
cz: {Sound:02:02}Dostavam hlad uz jen z te vune!

en: {Sound:01:FC}I want a red hat...
cz: {Sound:01:FC}Chci cervenou cepici...

en: {Sound:01:FC}I want a blue hat...
cz: {Sound:01:FC}Chci modrou cepici...

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Our reunion with the {Color:Green}Forest Minish{Color:White} is
still in full swing!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Nase setkani s {Color:Green}Lesnimi Minish{Color:White}
je stale v plnem proudu!

en:
{Sound:02:01}We're getting more refined just
BEING here!
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Stavame se rafinovanejsimi uz jen
tim, ze tady JSME!

en:
{Sound:02:01}Maybe I should just stay here and
never go back home...
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Mozna bych mel proste zustat tu a
nikdy se nevracet domu...

en: {Sound:02:05}What a wonderful smell...
cz: {Sound:02:05}Jak nadherna vune...

en: {Sound:02:03}We just love bread...
cz: {Sound:02:03}Proste milujeme chleba...

en:
{Sound:02:02}Sometimes I sneak off with a little
nibble of leftover bread.{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Nekdy se vyplizim s malym
kousnutim zbylyho chleba.{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:02:00}The bread {Color:Green}Wheaton {Color:White}makes has got
to be the best bread in Hyrule!
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Chleba, ktery {Color:Green}Wheaton {Color:White}peče, musi
byt ten nejlepsi chleba v Hyrule!

en: {Sound:01:FB}Isn't {Color:Green}Pita {Color:White}cute?
cz: {Sound:01:FB}Neni {Color:Green}Pita {Color:White}roztomila?

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Every one of their breads is
so delicious!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Kazdy z jejich chlebu je
tak vyborny!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}Those two newlyweds are being more
fresh than this fresh-baked bread!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Ti dva novomanzele jsou
cerstvejsi nez tento cerstvy chleba!{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:01:FA}It's such a thrill coming up here from
below, just like PSHOOOO!
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Je to takove vzruseni dostat se sem
zdola, prave jako PSHOOOO!

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Fewer and fewer people are coming
to buy bread...
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Stale mene a mene lidi prichazi
koupit chleba...

en:
{Sound:01:FC}I can't believe how dangerous
it's gotten around here...
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Nemuzu uverit, jak nebezpecne
to tu zacalo byt...

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Now more than ever, we all need to get
some good-luck bread!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Ted vic nez kdy jindy vsichni
potrebujeme chleba pro stesti!{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:01:FE}I like eating leftovers, but I just wish
business were going better for them...
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Rad jim zbytky, ale prece bych si pral,
aby se jim obchod darilo lepe...

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}025
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}026
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}027
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}028
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}029
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}030

{Sound:01:F8}Hmmm! I see! Oh, that makes sense!
...Human books are so interesting!
And that guy {Color:Green}Dr. Left{Color:White} living down there
has great taste in reading material!
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Hmmm! Aha! Och, to dava smysl!
...Lidske knihy jsou tak zajimave!
A ten chlap {Color:Green}Dr. Left{Color:White}, co bydli dole,
ma skvely vkus na knizky!

en:
{Sound:01:F9}I'm almost done with this book. I should
go nab another of the doctor's books.
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Skoro jsem dokoncil tuto knihu. Mel bych
bezet sebrat dalsi z doktorovych knih.

en:
{Sound:01:FA}I would love to read something a little
more romantic next...
cz:
{Sound:01:FA}Rad bych si dalsi precetl neco
malinko romantictejsiho...

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Ho! Ha! Hey!!

Phew... I want to {Color:Blue}return this book by
dropping it down below{Color:White}.
It's impossible without some
extra weight here...
But my brother is so busy with a book
of his own that he won't help me out!
Maybe I can do it if I try again...
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Ho! Ha! Hej!!

Fuj... Chci {Color:Blue}vratit tuto knihu tim,
ze ji shodim dolu{Color:White}.
Je to nemozne bez nejake
extra vahy tady...
Ale muj bratr je tak zaneprazdneny
vlastni knihou, ze mi nepomuze!
Mozna to dokazu, kdyz zkusim znovu...

en:
{Sound:01:FC}I think my brother is going to finish
that book he's reading soon.
I bet I'll have to return that one, too.
Guess I'd better put on a little weight!
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Myslim, ze muj bratr brzy dokonci
knihu, kterou cte.
Sazim, ze i tu budu muset vratit.
Asi bych mel pribrat trochu na vaze!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}My brother loves reading books!

And I love pushing my brother's books
off the rafters to return them!
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Muj bratr miluje cteni knih!

A ja miluju shazovani jeho knih
z tramu, abych je vratil!

en:
{Sound:02:01}It's a bit dusty up here, huh?
Maybe I should do a little cleaning...
cz:
{Sound:02:01}Je tu trochu prach, co?
Mozna bych mel trochu uklidit...

en:
{Sound:02:02}Thanks for cleaning up!
Now, all that dust is gone!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Diky za uklid!
Ted je veskery ten prach pryc!{Symbol:0B}

en: KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}039
KOBITO{Symbol:1F}HARI{Symbol:1F}040
SHICYO{Symbol:1F}TEI{Symbol:1F}000

Aherrrm herrmmm!
I am {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White}, mayor of this fair town!
Mayors are usually very important and
busy folk, I'll have you know...
But I still have a hobby, of course!
I collect unusual masks!
I just love them!
They're beautiful!
Simply magnificent, I tell you!
cz:
Ehmmm hmmmm!
Ja jsem {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White}, starosta tohoto mesta!
Starostove jsou obvykle velmi dulezite
a zaneprazdnene osoby, abys vedel...
Ale mam i konicek, samozrejme!
Sbiram neobvykle masky!
Proste je miluju!
Jsou nadherne!
Proste nadherne, rikam ti!

en:
Aherrm!

Yes! That's me, {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White}.
I am mayor of this town.
What's that? You want a book?
{Color:Red}A History of Masks{Color:White}?
And you say I checked it out,
do you? Yes, indeed I did...
Or wait... Did I?
cz:
Ehmmm!

Ano! To jsem ja, {Color:Green}Hagen{Color:White}.
Jsem starosta tohoto mesta.
Co je? Chces knihu?
{Color:Red}Historie masek{Color:White}?
A rikas, ze jsem si ji pujcil,
ano? Ano, opravdu pujcil...
Nebo pockej... Pujcil?

en:
Ahh, you seem to have found the book,
safe and sound and in fine shape!
But only because you listened to my
masks like a good little boy, right?
War har har har!
cz:
Ach, zda se, zes nasel knihu,
zdrava a v dobrem stavu!
Ale jen proto, zes poslouchal me
masky jako hodny chlapecek, ze?
Ha ha ha ha!

en:
I'm going to have to pick up volume 2.
That last book was just getting good!
cz:
Budu si muset vyzvednout dil 2.
Ta posledni kniha se prave stavala dobrou!

en:
{Sound:01:FE}The person living here is the mayor,
very important you know.
Doesn't it all just sound so...official?
cz:
{Sound:01:FE}Osoba, ktera zde zije, je starosta,
velmi dulezity, vis.
Nezni to vsechno tak...oficialne?

en:
{Sound:01:F8}The mayor likes strange masks.
Sometimes, he even makes his own.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Starosta ma rad podivne masky.
Nekdy si dokonce vyrabi vlastni.

en:
{Sound:01:FD}The mayor took off for his {Color:Green}cabin by the
lake{Color:White} clutching a {Color:Red}book{Color:White}. We saw him go...
But after the chest was opened, the
road to {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} was blocked.
You won't be able to get through.
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Starosta odjel do sve {Color:Green}chaty u
jezera{Color:White} s {Color:Red}knihou{Color:White} v ruce. Videli jsme ho jet...
Ale kdyz se truhla otevrela, cesta
do {Color:Green}Minish Lesu{Color:White} byla zablokovana.
Neprojdes tudy.

en:
{Sound:01:F6}When the {Color:Green}mayor {Color:White}came back, he didn't
have that {Color:Red}book {Color:White}anymore.
I'm sure he just left it at his {Color:Green}lakeside
cabin{Color:White}. He's pretty forgetful like that.
cz:
{Sound:01:F6}Kdyz se {Color:Green}starosta {Color:White}vratil, uz tu
{Color:Red}knihu {Color:White}nemel.
Urcite ji nechal ve sve {Color:Green}chate
u jezera{Color:White}. Je takto dost zapominciny.

en:
{Sound:01:FC}You want to go to the cabin
by the lake?
Well, let me just mark
it here on your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
Err... Yes! There. It's right here.
You should be able to find it now.
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Chces jit do chaty
u jezera?
No, dovol mi ji oznacit
zde na tve {Color:Red}mape{Color:White}.
Ehm... Ano! Tam. Je prave zde.
Ted bys ji mel umet najit.

en: {Sound:01:FD}So the {Color:Red}book {Color:White}WAS at the {Color:Green}lake{Color:White}, then.
cz: {Sound:01:FD}Takze ta {Color:Red}kniha {Color:White}BYLA u {Color:Green}jezera{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:01:F9}Ah, but I do love our absentminded
old mayor. He's a fine man.
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Ach, ale miluju naseho roztrziteho
stareho starostu. Je to dobry muz.

en:
You know, these masks see everything
that goes on in my private life.
Maybe you should just ask my masks!
cz:
Vis, tyto masky vidi vsechno,
co se deje v mem soukromem zivote.
Mozna by ses mel zeptat mych masek!

en:
I think I've finally got a good grasp
of how things run in {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}.
Things run so smoothly around here,
and I haven't even done a thing!
I wonder how much better this place
would be if I actually did anything!
cz:
Myslim, ze jsem konecne dobre pochopil,
jak veci funguji v {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}.
Veci tu bezi tak hladce
a ja jsem ani nic neudelal!
Zajimalo by me, o kolik lepsi by tohle
misto bylo, kdybych skutecne neco delal!

en:
Aherrm!! That hole in the garden leads
to a shelter of sorts.
But it's not like I'm trying to run off
and save myself alone or anything!
Just keep that in mind!
cz:
Ehmmm!! Ta dira v zahrade vede
do jakehosi ukrytu.
Ale to neznamena, ze se snazim utect
a zachranit jen sebe, nebo neco!
Jen to mej na pameti!

en:
I'm thinking of ways to increase the
library's budget to buy more books.
Especially the ones about masks,
you know.
cz:
Premyslim o zpusobech, jak zvysit
rozpocet knihovny na nakup knih.
Obzvlast tech o maskach,
vis.

en:
I may look somewhat idle to you,
but no, sir!
I will be working terrifically hard as
soon as you leave.
You can bet on that! Hoho!
cz:
Mozna ti pripadam trochu lenivy,
ale ne, pane!
Budu pracovat strasne tvrde,
jakmile odejdes.
Na to vsadis! Hoho!

en:
These are the times that really test my
mettle as a mayor, I tell you.
Hyrule is my responsibility to the last.
Everyone to the shelters!
cz:
Toto jsou casy, ktere opravdu testuji
muj charakter jako starosty, rikam ti.
Hyrule je ma zodpovednost do posledni chvile.
Vsichni do ukrytu!

en:
Monsters are coming!
Everyone stay indoors!
Oh, that doesn't apply to you, my boy!
You go get 'em, {Player}!
Your sword and bravery
will save the day!
cz:
Prichazeji monstra!
Vsichni zustante uvnitr!
Och, to se na tebe nevztahuje, chlapce!
Jdi po nich, {Player}!
Tvuj mec a statecnost
zachrani den!

en: SHICYO{Symbol:1F}TEI{Symbol:1F}019

I hope I don't sound like I'm bragging,
but I have a cabin at {Color:Green}Lake Hylia{Color:White}.
It's a gorgeous little place where I go
to enjoy my hobby, mask making.
cz:
Doufam, ze nezni, ze se chlubim,
ale mam chatu u {Color:Green}Jezera Hylia{Color:White}.
Je to nadherne mistecko, kam chodim
uzivat si svuj konicek, vyrobu masek.

en:
{Sound:01:F9}That {Color:Green}cabin by the lake{Color:White} is
really quite far.
cz:
{Sound:01:F9}Ta {Color:Green}chata u jezera{Color:White} je
opravdu dost daleko.

en:
{Sound:01:FD}The mayor wouldn't be nearly so
charming if he weren't so carefree.
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Starosta by zdaleka nebyl tak
oklavny, kdyby nebyl tak bezstarostny.

en: LEFT{Symbol:1F}000

What is all of this!?
I'm busy, don't you see that?
Do not disturb my research! If you have
no business, begone! You heard me!
cz:
Co to vsechno je!?
Jsem zaneprazdneny, nevidis to?
Nerus mi vyzkum! Pokud nemas
co delat, odejdi! Slysel jsi me!

en:
What, huh?
A book? From the library?
Ah, yes...of course. I knew this
day would come. Please, come in.
cz:
Co, ha?
Kniha? Z knihovny?
Ach, ano...samozrejme. Vedel jsem, ze
tento den prijde. Prosim, pojd dal.

en: LEFT{Symbol:1F}003
LEFT{Symbol:1F}004

I am a researcher of Picori legend
and lore. My name is {Color:Blue}Dr. Left{Color:White}.
You're here about that book,
{Color:Red}Legend of the Picori{Color:White}, aren't you?
Well, I hate to say this, but I haven't
seen it in several days.
Perhaps a mischievous little mouse
has taken it?
Well, I'm sure it's in this house
somewhere. I just don't know where.
But I'm very busy right now, so why
don't you just look for it yourself?
cz:
Jsem badatel Picori legend
a povesti. Jmenuji se {Color:Blue}Dr. Left{Color:White}.
Jsi tu kvuli te knize,
{Color:Red}Legenda o Picori{Color:White}, ze?
No, neradi to rikam, ale uz jsem ji
par dni nevidel.
Mozna ji vzala nejaka
zlomyslna mysicka?
No, urcite je nekde v tomto
dome. Jen nevim kde.
Ale ted jsem velmi zaneprazdneny,
tak proc si ji nehledas sam?

en:
A book fell with a "THUD!" a little
while ago.
It gave me such a shock that
my heart skipped a beat!
cz:
Pred chvili spadla kniha
s "BACH!".
Dalo mi to takovy sok, ze
mi srdce vynechalo!

en:
You found and returned the book for
me, did you? I'm very grateful.
Here, let me tell you something
interesting as thanks.
You see, the Minish did not always live
in our world.
No, they came through a secret portal
many ages ago from their world to ours!
But don't tell anyone! It's a valuable
bit of knowledge that only I know!
And I gleaned it only after hours of
study from an incredibly old book.
cz:
Nasel jsi a vratil mi knihu,
ano? Jsem velmi vdecny.
Dovol, abych ti rekl neco
zajimaveho jako diky.
Vidis, Minish nezili vzdy
v nasem svete.
Ne, prisli pred mnoha vekey skrz
tajny portal ze sveho sveta do naseho!
Ale nikomu to nerikej! Je to cenny
kousek znalosti, ktery zna jen ja!
A ja jsem to vylustil az po
hodinach studia z neuveritelne stare knihy.

en:
So you've come to hear more about the
Minish, have you?
Well, I can part with one more tidbit,
I suppose... It could be useful.
The portal linking us to the Minish
world opens only once every 100 years.
That means the Minish here now are
descendants of those who came before.
That's right! Those Minish came here
100 years ago, or even longer ago!
Now that the portal is open this year,
perhaps new Minish will come through...
cz:
Tak jsi prisel slyset vic o
Minish, ano?
No, mohu se rozloucit s dalsim drobtem,
asi... Mohlo by to byt uzitecne.
Portal spojujici nas se svetem
Minish se otvira jen jednou za 100 let.
To znamena, ze Minish, kteri jsou tu ted,
jsou potomci tech, kteri prisli pred nimi.
Presne tak! Ti Minish sem prisli
pred 100 lety nebo jeste drive!
Ted kdyz je portal letos otevren,
mozna projdou novi Minish...

en:
The more I study the Minish, the closer
I feel to them!
It's almost as if they were right
here with me, all the time...
cz:
Cim vic studuji Minish, tim blize
se k nim citim!
Jako by byli prave
tady se mnou, porad...

en:
I never leave my house, whether there
are monsters outside or not!
cz:
Nikdy neopoustim svuj dum, at uz
jsou venku monstra, nebo ne!

en:
Hey, do you know the clues that reveal
the location of the treasure?
{Color:Blue}Cross the bridge that spans
the rapid flow...
Through the land of
the fearsome beast...
Until you reach
the misty falls...
The treasure sleeps on the other side
of the secret entrance there...{Color:White}
They say it's a magical tool that allows
even little people to push big things!
According to the legend, you're
supposed to start from this house!
cz:
Hej, znas indicie, ktere odhaluji
umisteni pokladu?
{Color:Blue}Prejdi most, ktery prekonava
prudky proud...
Skrze zemi
strasidelne sevre...
Az dorazis k
mlhavym vodopadum...
Poklad spi na druhe strane
tajneho vchodu tam...{Color:White}
Rikaji, ze je to magicky nastroj, ktery
umoznuje i malym lidem strkat velke veci!
Podle legendy mas zacit
z tohoto domu!

en:
{Sound:01:FB}Ahh... What should I do? Should I stay
or go? If I go, there could be...
...What's that?

You've already found the {Color:Red}bracelet {Color:White}that
makes one strong?!
Ahhh, I knew it! I'd been stumped on
that for so long! I knew I'd lose out!
cz:
{Sound:01:FB}Ach... Co mam delat? Mam zustat
nebo jit? Pokud pujdu, mohlo by tam byt...
...Co je?

Uz jsi nasel {Color:Red}naramek{Color:White}, ktery
cloveka udela silnym?!
Achhh, vedel jsem to! Byl jsem v tom
zaseknuty tak dlouho! Vedel jsem, ze prohraju!

en:
{Sound:01:FC}You're so brave!
I really respect that!
cz:
{Sound:01:FC}Jsi tak statecny!
Opravdu si toho vazim!

en:
{Sound:01:FD}Have you been using the {Color:Red}bracelet {Color:White}that
makes you strong? Must come in handy!
cz:
{Sound:01:FD}Pouzival jsi {Color:Red}naramek{Color:White}, ktery te
dela silnym? Musi se hodit!

en:
Oh, look! You've found it! Could I ask
you to return that {Color:Red}book {Color:White}for me, lad?
cz:
Och, podivej! Nasel jsi ji! Mohu te
pozadat, abys mi tu {Color:Red}knihu {Color:White}vratil, chlapce?

en:
Hey.
What do you want?
My sister's not here.
She's at school.
cz:
Hej.
Co chces?
Moje sestra tu neni.
Je ve skole.

en:
You have a weird hat. Where can
I get one of those?
cz:
Mas divnou cepici. Kde
bych takovou mohl ziskat?

en: Aaaarf!
cz: Aaaarf!

en:
My dog's real smart.
And a little spoiled, too.
cz:
Muj pes je opravdu chytry.
A trochu rozmazleny take.

en:
My sister's back now.
I guess she's supposed to stay in.
cz:
Moje sestra je zpatky.
Asi ma zustat doma.

en:
{Sound:00:D1}Awooo! Hot! Awoo!
{Color:Blue}The fireplace is too hot!{Color:White}
My master won't come home, 'cuz he's
head over heels for the girl next door.
But when he puts the fire out, then
sometimes mice come out...
I hate mice, so either way,
I'm never happy!
cz:
{Sound:00:D1}Awooo! Horko! Awoo!
{Color:Blue}V krbu je moc horko!{Color:White}
Muj pan se nevraci domu, protoze je
po usi zamilovany do sousedky.
Ale kdyz uhasi ohen, pak nekdy
vyleznou mysi...
Mam nenavidim mysi, tak at tak nebo
onak, nikdy nejsem stastny!

en:
{Sound:00:D1}It's too hot! Arf...
{Color:Blue}The fireplace is too hot...{Color:White}
Now there are even more people in here,
and it's getting too hot to bear!
What will it take to cool this place
down!? Pant, pant, pant!
cz:
{Sound:00:D1}Je moc horko! Arf...
{Color:Blue}V krbu je moc horko...{Color:White}
Ted je tu jeste vic lidi a
je to moc horko k vydrzeni!
Co to bude stat to misto
ochladit!? Funi, funi, funi!

en:
{Sound:00:D1}Thanks, arf!
You put out the fire.
But I'm still miffed at my master!

I can't believe how long he's been
hanging out with his girlfriend!
Arf! Arf!
cz:
{Sound:00:D1}Diky, arf!
Uhasil jsi ohen.
Ale stale jsem nastvany na sveho pana!

Nemuzu uverit, jak dlouho je
se svou pritelkyni!
Arf! Arf!

en:
Huh? A {Color:Red}book {Color:White}from the {Color:Green}library{Color:White}?

{Color:Red}A Hyrulean Bestiary{Color:White}, is that the one?
Yeah, I checked it out a while ago.
You came all this way to get it?
Wow! You're one dedicated librarian!
But... I don't know how to tell you
this, but it's back at my house.
Would you mind going there to get it?
I just can't leave right now, see...
cz:
Ha? {Color:Red}Kniha {Color:White}z {Color:Green}knihovny{Color:White}?

{Color:Red}Hyrulska bestiar{Color:White}, ta je to?
Jo, pujcil jsem si ji pred chvili.
Prisel jsi az sem ji ziskat?
Wow! Jsi opravdu oddany knihovnik!
Ale... Nevim, jak ti to mam rict,
ale je zpatky u me doma.
Vadilo by ti tam jit a vyzvednout ji?
Ja odsud ted nemuzu odejit, vis...

en:
They say the king's been weird lately.

But that doesn't really have anything
to do with our love...
cz:
Rikaji, ze kral byl posledne divny.

Ale to nema opravdu nic
spolecneho s nasi laskou...

en:
I'm writing a letter right now, so I
don't have any time to play with you.
Sorry.
cz:
Prave ted pisu dopis, takze
nemam cas si s tebou hrat.
Promin.

en:
You returned my book?
Thanks!
cz:
Vratil jsi mou knihu?
Diky!

en:
They say the king's been weird lately.

But that doesn't really have anything
to do with our love...
cz:
Rikaji, ze kral byl posledne divny.

Ale to nema opravdu nic

en:
You ought to be careful when you're
running around! You're awfully tiny!
And not all dogs and cats are nice,
like me. Woof!
Some of them might even take a swipe
at you, arf! Rarf!
cz:
Mel bys byt opatrny, kdyz pobihas
kolem! Jsi strasne maly!
A ne vsichni psi a kocky jsou tak hodni
jako ja. Haf!
Nekteri po tobe mohou dokonce
sahnout, arf! Rarf!

MINKA{Symbol:1F}020

My brother's at school.

Och, ahoj.
Muj bratr je ve skole.

Sorry.

Prave ted pisu dopis, takze
nemam cas si s tebou hrat.
Promin.

cz: {Sound:00:D2}Mnauu-mnauuu!!!

en: {Sound:00:D2}Sssss!
cz: {Sound:00:D2}Sssss!

en:
My brother's back. Now, he's not
allowed out anymore...
cz:
Muj bratr je zpatky. Ted nesmi
uz ven...

en:
Dear Mom,
Gone to Julietta's house. Back soon.
cz:
Mila mami,
Idu k Juliette domu. Brzy zpet.

en:
{Sound:02:02}It's really dangerous up ahead! You
can't just charge through recklessly!
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Pred nami je opravdu nebezpecno! Nemuzes
prosto utocit bezhlavym zpusobem!

en:
{Sound:02:02}Hey, I've heard about you... So you're
gonna go ahead, are you?
Well, onward to glory then!
Just don't die out there, OK?
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Hej, slysel jsem o tobe... Tak ty se
chystas jit dal, ano?
No, kupredu ke slave tedy!
Jen tam nezemri, OK?

en:
{Sound:02:02}You made it through that den of evil
and came back alive?!
Amazing! Whoo! Whoo!
cz:
{Sound:02:02}Prosel jsi tim doupatem zla
a vratil ses zivy?!
Uzasne! Whuu! Whuu!

en:
I come from a faraway land. You
can tell by my clothing, can't you?
cz:
Pochazim z daleke zeme. To
poznas podle meho obleceni, ne?

en:
This place isn't so bad once you get
used to it. I like it here.
cz:
Toto misto neni tak spatne, az si
zvyknes. Libi se mi tu.

en:
In this cool climate, my clothes are
a little on the unprotective side.
cz:
V tomto chladnem klimatu je moje
obleceni trochu malo chranici.

en:
I'm thinking about calling my family
over soon.
Living with your feet on the ground
is not so bad, I've decided.
cz:
Premyslim, ze pozvu svou rodinu
brzy.
Zit s nohama na zemi neni
tak spatne, rozhodla jsem se.

en:
So you've been to my hometown?
It's great, isn't it?
cz:
Tak jsi byl v mem rodnem meste?
Je skvele, ze?

en:
Monsters could attack at any time.
Maybe I shouldn't call my family over.
cz:
Monstra mohou kdykoli zautocit.
Mozna bych nemela volat svou rodinu.

en:
{Sound:01:FF}I really like this house. This is the
best place in this whole human town!
I want to stay here forever.
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Opravdu se mi libi tento dum. Je to
nejlepsi misto v celem tomto lidskem meste!
Chci tu zustat navzdy.

en:
{Sound:01:FF}This place is getting a little run-down.
I'm thinking about rebuilding the place.
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Toto misto je trochu zdevastovane.
Premyslim, ze ho prestavim.

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Welcome!

This is my new house! Ah... Don't
you just love that new-house smell?
And I was JUST thinking about building
a new house, so this is great!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Vitej!

Toto je muj novy dum! Ach... Nemilujes
proste tu vuni noveho domu?
A PROSTO jsem premyslel o stavbe
noveho domu, takze je to skvele!

en:
{Sound:01:FF}Imagine moving from a musty old
mushroom to a fabulous house like this!
It's like a dream come true!
cz:
{Sound:01:FF}Predstav si stehovani ze zatuchle stare
houby do bajecneho domu jako je tento!
Je to jako splneny sen!

en:
Well, I suppose I'd better get dinner
started! Hmm hm hmmm!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
No, asi bych mela zacit pripravovat
veceri! Hmm hm hmmm!{Symbol:0B}

en:
Oooh, scary... Well, as long as nothing
else happens...
cz:
Oooh, strasidelne... No, dokud se
nestane neco jineho...

en: What's a moss-ster?
cz: Co je to mochovstro?

en:
It's so boring not being
able to go outside.
cz:
Je to tak nudne, kdyz nemuzu
jit ven.

en:
{Sound:02:00}The boss might seem rough, but he's
a real softy at heart...
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Sef se muze zdat drsny, ale
v srdci je to opravdovy mekoun...

en:
{Sound:02:00}The boss is a real refined fella, right?
Anybody what's smart can see dat!
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Sef je opravdu rafinovany chlap, ze?
Kazdy, kdo je chytry, to vidi!

en:
{Sound:02:00}I would like to apprentice to the boss,
too, but he barely even notices me...
It's so sad.
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Rad bych se ucil u sefa,
take, ale on me sotva vsima...
Je to tak smutne.

en:
{Sound:02:00}They call him Punch Mutoh because he's
like a real punchy fella and all dat.
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Rikaji mu Punch Mutoh, protoze je
jako opravdovy udernicky chlapik a tak.

en:
{Sound:02:00}The boss is the number-one builder in
town. You need a building, you see him.
cz:
{Sound:02:00}Sef je nejlepsi stavitel ve
meste. Potrebujes budovu, jdi za nim.

We do our best to make this a nice,
cozy place, where people can relax.
My ideal cafe is a place where everyone
can just let it all hang out. Ah, yeah.

Snazime se ze vsech sil, aby to tu bylo
pekne utulne misto, kde mohou lide relaxovat.
Ma idealni kavarna je misto, kde se kazdy
muze proste uvolnit. Ach, jo.

in here. Stop by from time to time.

Slychame tu vsechny mozne zajimave drby.
Zaskoc obcas.

en:
Make yourself at home...
Heehee...
cz:
Citej se jako doma...
Hihi...

en:
I am a laid-back, easygoing kind
of guy. Not a care in the world.
And that's just the way I like it!
cz:
Jsem v pohode, bezstarostny
chlapik. Nic me netrapi.
A takhle se mi to libi!

en:
He who can enjoy a nice cup of
steaming hot tea at his leisure...
is truly master of his own time.
cz:
Ten, kdo si muze v klidu uzit
pekny salek pareho horkeho caje...
je opravdu panem sveho casu.

en:
Let me tell you something that
might come in handy someday.
You can move bookcases and stuff.
Try to {Color:Blue}push and pull different things{Color:White}...
After all, you're young! You should
be trying all kinds of new things! Ha!
cz:
Reknu ti neco, co se ti
mozna nekdy hodi.
Muzes hybat knihovnami a podobne.
Zkus {Color:Blue}strkat a tahat ruzne veci{Color:White}...
Koneckoncu, jsi mlady! Mel bys
zkouset vsechny mozne nove veci! Ha!

en: I'm one smart cookie!
cz: Jsem jeden chytry kousek!

Just me and my cuppa joe.

Toto je muj zvlastni cas...

cz: No, ja vlastne kavu nepiju...

It seems the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}has commanded all of
the guards to search for magic power.
Folks say that this "{Color:Red}light force{Color:White}" will
grant any wish, but I don't buy it...

Zda se, ze {Color:Green}kral {Color:White}narídil vsem strazcum,
aby hledali magickou silu.
Lide rikaji, ze tato "{Color:Red}svetelna sila{Color:White}" splni
kazde prani, ale ja tomu neverim...

en:

thing for dinner we had last night...
cz:
Zajimalo by me, jestli nemuzeme mit

{Sound:01:F8}This cafe is so busy. You can hear all

{Sound:01:F8}Tato kavarna je tak rusna. Slychas tu
vsechny mozne veci od vsech lidi.

en:
{Sound:01:F8}It's just right for people like us who
thrive on the hustle and bustle, huh?
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Je to akorat pro lidi jako my, kteri
zili z ruchu a shonu, co?

en:
{Sound:01:F8}It's hard not to get stepped on when
there are so many people here.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Je tezke nezuslapnout, kdyz je

Welcome!

Posad se, kam chces,

Talking only to oneself...

Hohohoho!

{Sound:01:F8}Vitej zpatky, zlaticko!
Rada te vidim!

{Sound:01:F8}The old lady in front of this house
drinks nothing but milk.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Stara dama pred timto domem
nepije nic jineho nez mleko.

Welcome back, you!
You're my favorite customer!
cz:
Vitej zpatky!
Jsi muj oblibeny zakaznik!

en:
So you've been good lately?
Gooood, heehee...
cz:
Tak ses posledne choval dobre?
Dobreee, hihi...

en:
You can tell all of your deepest
secrets to a wall.
The wall will never talk back.
cz:
Muzes rict vsechna sva nejhlubsi
tajemstvi zdi.
Zed nikdy neodpovi.

en:
But I've found if you talk to 'em right,
walls will give up all sorts of secrets!
cz:
Ale zjistil jsem, ze kdyz s nimi spravne
mluvis, zdi vydaji vsechna mozna tajemstvi!

You're going to the {Color:Green}Royal Valley{Color:White}?
I hear that place is haunted...
But there's a secret entrance that will
get you there from {Color:Green}Hyrule Field{Color:White}.
I mean, that's what I've heard.

Jdes do {Color:Green}Kralovskeho udoli{Color:White}?
Slysel jsem, ze tam straci...
Ale je tam tajny vchod, ktery
te tam dostane z {Color:Green}Hyrulske pole{Color:White}.
Tedy, to jsem slysel.

en:
That place is dark even in the daytime.

And you know how ghosts love
the dark! Hohohoho...
cz:
To misto je tmave i pres den.

A vis, jak duchove miluji
tmu! Hohohoho...

en:

milk for dinner?

Proc nemuzeme mit jen
mleko k veceri?

Good to see you.

{Sound:01:F8}Och, ahoj...

What is truth?

dobyjeme i samotny cas...

The{Color:Green} source of the flow{Color:White}? Well, that's

The water flowing into {Color:Green}town {Color:White}and into
the {Color:Green}lake {Color:White}all comes from the same place.
Hohohoh...

{Color:Green}Zdroj toku{Color:White}? No, to je
snadne. Mluvi se o vode!
Voda tekouci do {Color:Green}mesta {Color:White}a do
{Color:Green}jezera {Color:White}prichazi vsechna ze stejneho mista.
Hohohoh...

Well, you'd better make sure you're
well equipped is all I'm sayin'! Hohoho!

Pokud hledas {Color:Green}zdroj
toku{Color:White}...

dobre vybaven, to je vse, co rikam! Hohoho!

en:
Cheers! Yaay! Cheers!
Raise your milk for a toast!
I wonder...do we even need to eat
dinner at all?
cz:
Na zdravi! Hura! Na zdravi!
Zvedni mleko k pripitku!
Zajimalo by me...musime vubec
vecerit?

en:
I wonder...do we even need to eat
dinner at all?
cz:
Zajimalo by me...musime vubec
vecerit?

en: {Sound:01:F8}Welcome, sugar pie!
cz: {Sound:01:F8}Vitej, sladka kolacku!

en:
{Sound:01:F8}It's so convenient to live in a human
house as a Minish.
cz:
{Sound:01:F8}Je tak vyhodne zit v lidskem
dome jako Minish.

en:
Everyone's so relaxed here.
That's a good thing.
A place where you can relax despite
what's going on outside.
That's my idea of a good cafe.
cz:
Vsichni jsou tu tak uvolneni.
To je dobra vec.
Misto, kde se muzes uvolnit i pres to,
co se deje venku.
To je moje predstava dobre kavarny.

cz:

co se deje venku.
To je moje predstava dobre kavarny.

en:
Heeeey!
Weeeelcome!
cz:
Heeeej!
Vitejteee!

en:
You're turning into a fine little man,
aren't you! Heehee...
cz:
Stavas se z tebe pekny mlady muz,
co! Hihi...

en:
Though I am nondescript, you notice me
and talk to me.
That makes me the prize, and you
are the winner of that prize!
cz:
I kdyz jsem neprime, vsimas si me
a mluvis se mnou.
To ze me dela cenu a ty
jsi vitez te ceny!

en: Someday, you will understand.
cz: Jednou pochopis.

en:
I hear a guard who was looking for the
{Color:Red}light force {Color:White}got thrown in the dungeon!
Why, the {Color:Green}king {Color:White}is hardly worthy of being
called "noble" anymore!
cz:
Slysel jsem, ze strazce, ktery hledal
{Color:Red}svetelnou silu{Color:White}, byl uvrzen do zalare!
Proc, {Color:Green}kral {Color:White}uz neni hoden byt
nazyvan "vznesenym"!

en:
But I should be careful, lest I be jailed
myself just for criticizing the {Color:Green}king{Color:White}!
cz:
Ale mel bych byt opatrny, abych
nebyl uveznen za kritiku {Color:Green}krale{Color:White}!

en:
Cheers! Yaay! Cheers!
Raise your milk for a toast!
It's not like the world would come to an
end if I didn't make dinner, right?
cz:
Na zdravi! Hura! Na zdravi!
Zvedni mleko k pripitku!
Neni to, ze by svet skoncil,
kdybych neudelala veceri, ze?

en:
It's not like the world would come to an
end if I didn't make dinner, right?
cz:
Neni to, ze by svet skoncil,
kdybych neudelala veceri, ze?

en:
Everyone's so relaxed here.
That's a good thing.
A place where you could happily let the
world crumble around you.
That's my idea of a good cafe.
cz:
Vsichni jsou tu tak uvolneni.
To je dobra vec.
Misto, kde bys mohl stastne nechat
svet rozpadat se kolem tebe.
To je moje predstava dobre kavarny.

That's my idea of a good cafe.
cz:
Misto, kde bys mohl stastne nechat
svet rozpadat se kolem tebe.
To je moje predstava dobre kavarny.

en:
Hey there!
Doin' well?
cz:
Cau!
Dari se?

en:
We're counting on you, young man!
Heehee!
cz:
Pocitame s tebou, mlady muzi!
Hihi!

en:
Everything with a beginning
also has an end.
To put it another way, all things move
toward their end...
Even from the moment they begin.
cz:
Vsechno, co ma zacatek,
ma take konec.
Jinymi slovy, vsechny veci se hybou
ke svemu konci...
Uz od chvile, kdy zacnou.

en:
The end is near.
For me, as well as for you.
cz:
Konec je blizko.
Pro me, stejne jako pro tebe.

en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} is covered in darkness.
This is the end.
cz:
{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White} je zahalen temnotou.
Toto je konec.

en:
I never imagined something like this
would happen in my lifetime.
I wonder if the {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}will show up
and help us once again...
cz:
Nikdy jsem si nepredstavoval, ze se
neco takoveho stane za meho zivota.
Zajimalo by me, jestli se {Color:Green}Picori {Color:White}objevi
a pomohou nam zase...

en:
Cheers! Yaay! Cheers!
Raise your milk for a toast!
I never knew that failing to make
dinner would have such consequences!
cz:
Na zdravi! Hura! Na zdravi!
Zvedni mleko k pripitku!
Nikdy jsem nevedela, ze nepripravit
veceri ma takove dusledky!

en:
I never knew that failing to make
dinner would have such consequences!
cz:
Nikdy jsem nevedela, ze nepripravit
veceri ma takove dusledky!

en:
Just try fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} with
lots of people.
There are a lot of people out there
looking for someone to fuse with.
cz:
Proste zkus spojit {Color:Blue}kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}
s hodne lidmi.
Venku je hodne lidi,
kteri hledaji nekoho na spojeni.

en:
You'd be surprised to find who--and
what--you can {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones {Color:White}with!
Yeah, you've got a lot of fusing in
your future, pal...
cz:
Divil by ses, s kym--a s cim--
muzes {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}!
Jo, ceka te ve tve budoucnosti
spousta spojovani, kamo...

en:
I recommend visiting {Color:Blue}places you've
already been{Color:White}.
You may then be able to fuse Kinstone
pieces in those places, you know?
cz:
Doporucuji navstivit {Color:Blue}mista, kde
jsi uz byl{Color:White}.
Mozna pak budes moct spojit kousky
Kamene osudu na tech mistech, vis?

en:
You can get special items by fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}!
Don't miss out on the opportunity!
cz:
Muzes ziskat specialni predmety spojenim
{Color:Blue}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White}!
Neprijdi o prilezitost!

en:
There's a {Color:Green}group of lovely young ladies
{Color:White}visiting Hyrule...
Maybe I'll get a chance to talk to them
if I offer to fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}. Heh.
cz:
V Hyrule navstevuje {Color:Green}skupinka peknych
mladych dam{Color:White}...
Mozna budu mit sanci s nimi mluvit,
kdyz jim nabidnu spojeni {Color:Blue}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White}. Heh.

en:
I hear there's a wall in {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}
with a spot for a {Color:Blue}Kinstone piece{Color:White}.
I'm sure you can find other places
where you can place Kinstone pieces.
cz:
Slysel jsem, ze v {Color:Green}Minish Lese{Color:White}
je zed s mistem pro {Color:Blue}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}.
Urcite najdes i jina mista,
kam muzes umistit kousky Kamene osudu.

en:
Do you know of the {Color:Green}Goron Cave{Color:White}? It's a
tunnel that the {Color:Green}Gorons {Color:White}are digging.
And if you can get all the way to the
cave's end and place a {Color:Blue}Kinstone{Color:White}...
Well, why don't I just let you try it
for yourself!
cz:
Znas {Color:Green}Goronskou Jeskyni{Color:White}? Je to
tunel, ktery {Color:Green}Goroni {Color:White}kopaji.
A kdyz se dostanes az na konec
jeskyne a umistis {Color:Blue}Kamen osudu{Color:White}...
No, proc te nenechame, abys to
zkusil sam!

en:
I hear you can fuse {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}
with the {Color:Green}ghost {Color:White}in the {Color:Green}Royal Crypt{Color:White}.
Or at least so I hear. I'm too scared
to find out for sure.
cz:
Slysel jsem, ze muzes spojit {Color:Blue}kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}
s {Color:Green}duchem {Color:White}v {Color:Green}Kralovske Kryptě{Color:White}.
Nebo aspon to jsem slysel. Mam moc
strach to ziskat jiste.

en:
You can't always just charge straight
ahead to new places in life, you know.
You need to go back to places you've
already been and reflect on things.
Who knows? That quiet reflection may
give you a chance to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
cz:
Nemuzes vzdy jen utocit primo
vpred na nova mista v zivote, vis.
Musis se vracet na mista, kde jsi
uz byl, a premyslet o vecech.
Kdo vi? Ta tiche uvaha ti muze
dat sanci {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}!

en:
You know, fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} can
get you more than mere {Color:Red}Rupees{Color:White}...
It can call new people to a place or
even change the way the town looks.
And all those things can lead
to happiness as well, right?
cz:
Vis, spojovani {Color:Blue}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White} ti muze
prinest vice nez jen {Color:Red}rupie{Color:White}...
Muze pritahnout nove lidi na misto nebo
dokonce zmenit, jak mesto vypada.
A vsechny ty veci mohou vest
take ke stesti, ze?

en:
Are you enjoying fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White}?
Fusing can bring happiness to you and
your fusing buddy! That's what I say!
cz:
Bavi te spojovani {Color:Blue}kousku Kamene
osudu{Color:White}?
Spojovani muze prinest stesti tobe a
tvemu spojovacimu kamaradovi! To rikam!

en:
I wonder what happens if you fuse all
of the Kinstones a person is holding...
cz:
Zajimalo by me, co se stane, kdyz spojis
vsechny Kameny osudu, ktere clovek drzi...

en:
{Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White} has fallen to the
darkness...
I suppose this is no time to be fusing
{Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}, is it?
cz:
{Color:Green}Hrad Hyrule{Color:White} padl do
temnoty...
Asi ted neni cas spojovat
{Color:Blue}kousky Kamene osudu{Color:White}, ze?

en:
Nonsense! Maybe we need it now more
than ever before!
Fusing {Color:Blue}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} can bring
people happiness!
This is the true motive for fusing, my
friend! Not Rupees, but happiness!
cz:
Nesmysl! Mozna to potrebujeme ted vic
nez kdy predtim!
Spojovani {Color:Blue}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White} muze prinest
lidem stesti!
Toto je pravy motiv pro spojovani,
muj prateli! Ne rupie, ale stesti!
